description: This is an abstract PHP class defining core logic for leave allocation in an HR management system. It includes methods for handling leave requests, overlap detection, leave duration calculations, and work schedule interactions, intended to be extended by concrete implementations.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationService
classes.description: An abstract class that provides core functionality for managing leave allocations, overlaps, and scheduling based on employee leave requests and work schedules. Designed to be extended for specific leave allocation strategies.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to save a leave request and send associated notifications.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the status of a leave request based on day types and leave parameters.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Abstract method to specify if leave balances can be exceeded.

methods.name: getOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leaves overlapping with a given leave request, considering partial days and work schedules.

methods.name: hasOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Checks if there are any overlapping leaves for the given leave parameters.

methods.name: isEmployeeAllowedToApply
methods.description: Determines if an employee is allowed to apply for a given leave type; defaults to true.

methods.name: isWorkShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Checks if a leave request exceeds the allowed work shift length hours for the employee.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLengthExceedOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Returns the list of leaves that cause the work shift length to be exceeded based on the leave parameters.

methods.name: generateLeaveRequest
methods.description: Creates and initializes a LeaveRequest object based on leave parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDurationForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the work shift length for a specific employee.

methods.name: getApplicableLeaveDuration
methods.description: Determines the leave duration (full day, half day, specific time) based on whether it's the first or last day of a multi-day leave.

methods.name: updateLeaveDurationParameters
methods.description: Updates a Leave object's duration type, start and end times, and hours based on leave duration and schedule details.

methods.name: addHoursDuration
methods.description: Adds a specified number of hours to a DateTime object and returns the new DateTime.

methods.name: getDurationInHours
methods.description: Calculates the duration in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: createLeaveObjectListForAppliedRange
methods.description: Generates a list of Leave objects for each day in the requested leave date range.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Determines if a specific date should be treated as a half-day leave based on the employee's schedule.

methods.name: isWeekend
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a weekend according to the employee's schedule.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a holiday according to the schedule.

methods.name: isHalfdayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.
